name: doctor_example
description: Script of the example native mod (examples/native-class): calls the Lua functions the mod's DLLs add. On start it prints a sum and a text made by the C mod; on the message doctor_example_query it prints the numbers of DoctorCounterInfo() and sends doctor_example_count through DoctorSend.

params.code:
local heard = DoctorSend("doctor_example_count")
local objects, counted, sent, pings, swallowed, eclipse = DoctorCounterInfo()
print("doctor_example:query:" .. tostring(heard) .. ":" .. objects .. ":" .. counted .. ":" .. sent .. ":" .. pings .. ":" .. swallowed .. ":" .. eclipse)
